title: Creamy Herb Pasta Bake
description: A rich and flavorful pasta dish with a creamy herb sauce and a crunchy brown rice crust.

ingredients.name: chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley, basil)

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large saucepan, combine the cooked pasta, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and chopped fresh herbs.
In a separate saucepan, heat the brown rice over low heat until warmed through.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the pasta with the brown rice, spreading it evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
